problem.read: We could not open the form
problem.readBody: Nothing is lost. Try again in a moment.
problem.notice: Read how your measurements are used first
problem.noticeBody: Tick it on the first step: no measurement or photo goes before that.
problem.noticeChangedBody: {sender} published a new version since you read it: read it and tick it again on the first step.
problem.noNotice: The form is not open yet
problem.noNoticeBody: {sender} has not published its privacy notice yet. Ask them: the form opens once it is.
problem.unavailable: We could not reach the server
problem.unavailableBody: Nothing was sent twice. Try again in a moment.
problem.internal: Something went wrong on our side
problem.internalBody: Nothing is lost. Try again; if it happens again, write to {sender}.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries in a short time
problem.rateLimitedBody: Wait a minute, then try again.
problem.uploadsClosed: Photos cannot be sent right now
problem.uploadsClosedBody: We check every photo before keeping it, and the check is not running. Send the form without photos where they are optional, or try again later.
problem.photosFullBody: Send the form with the photos you have, or ask {sender} for a new link.
problem.fixBody: We took you to the first one. Each field says what to change.
problem.photosBusy: A photo is still on its way
problem.photosBusyBody: Wait until it shows as sent, then send the form.

draft.restoredBody: Go on where you stopped, or start again with an empty form.

later.held: Type something first: there is nothing to keep yet.
later.savedBody: Open this link again until {day} to finish. Nothing is kept on this device.

held.notice: Tick that you read how your measurements are used first.
held.noNotice: {sender} has not published its privacy notice yet.
held.photos: A photo is still on its way.

start.title: Before you start
start.lead: {sender} asks for your measurements. Read how they are used, then start.

basics.title: About you
basics.lead: The pattern department needs these three.

points.title: Measurements
points.lead: Point by point: the picture shows where the tape goes. Enter takes you to the next point.

fit.title: How you like it
fit.lead: What the fitter should know about how you ride and wear it.

photos.title: Photos
photos.lead: Front, side and back in a base layer help the pattern maker.

review.title: Check and send
review.lead: Every value in one table. Change anything before you send it.

intro.title: What this is
intro.who: {sender} makes your {garment} to measure and asks for your measurements.
intro.whoOrder: {sender} makes your {garment} to measure (order {order}) and asks for your measurements.
intro.helper: Someone to help: most points cannot be measured alone.
intro.layerRequired: A base layer or close-fitting clothes for the photos (needed).
intro.layerOptional: A base layer or close-fitting clothes for the photos (if you want to add them).
intro.later: You can stop and finish later from this link until {day}: we keep your answers.

privacy.title: Your data
privacy.lead: Your measurements and photos are personal data
privacy.what: What we collect: your height, weight and age, the measurements below, how you like the fit and, if you add them, three photos of you in a base layer.
privacy.why: Why: {sender} uses them only to make your garment to measure and to check its fit.
privacy.keep: How long: the photos are deleted {days} days after your garment ships; the measurements stay with your profile until you ask us to delete them.
privacy.who: Who sees them: the people at {sender} who make and check your garment. Nobody else.
privacy.full: Read the full privacy notice (version {version}) in a new tab
privacy.tick: I have read how my measurements are used
privacy.tickFirst: Tick it to start: no field opens before it.
privacy.tickFailed: We could not keep your tick. Try again.
privacy.held: Every field stays closed until you tick it.
privacy.missing: {sender} has not published its privacy notice yet
privacy.missingBody: The form opens once it is. Ask them.

basics.why: We keep centimetres and kilograms; inches and pounds are turned into them exactly.

issue.OUT_OF_LIMITS: {field}: this cannot be right. Check the number and the units.
issue.PHOTO_REQUIRED: This photo is needed. Take it, or take it again.
issue.UNKNOWN_POINT: {field}: not a point of this form.
issue.SAME_PHOTO: Take a different photo for each view.

points.none: Your garment has no points to measure here: send the basics and the photos.

hint.BELOW_RANGE: {point} {value} is less than usual (from {bound}): check it. You can still send it.
hint.ABOVE_RANGE: {point} {value} is more than usual (up to {bound}): check it. You can still send it.
hint.FOR_HEIGHT: {point} {value} is unusual for a height of {bound}: check it. You can still send it.

SNUG.title: Snug
SNUG.body: Close to the body, as for racing.

REGULAR.title: Regular
REGULAR.body: Room for a layer underneath, as for touring.

fit.postureHint: How you sit on the bike: racing crouch, upright, long reach…
fit.asymmetryHint: For example one arm or leg longer, one shoulder lower.

photos.leadRequired: Three photos are needed: front, side and back.
photos.leadOptional: Three photos help the pattern maker: front, side and back. You can send the form without them.
photos.howLayer: Wear a base layer or close-fitting clothes.
photos.howStand: Stand straight, arms a little away from the body, the whole body in the picture.
photos.howFace: Your face is not needed: keep it out of the picture.
photos.kept: We keep the photos with us (never on this device) and delete them {days} days after your garment ships.
photos.failed: This photo did not reach us.

dialogIntro.FRONT: Face the camera; the outline shows where to stand.
dialogIntro.SIDE: Turn to your right side; arms relaxed.
dialogIntro.BACK: Turn your back to the camera.

photos.readFailed: We could not show this photo now; it is kept with us. Try again.

review.lead: Check every value. Change takes you to its step; what you typed stays.
review.hintsBody: They look unusual. If they are right, send them as they are.
review.name: Your name (optional)
review.nameHint: Who measured: it goes with the measurements.

step.stand: Stand straight and relaxed, in a base layer, feet a little apart.
step.tape: Let your helper hold the tape where the picture shows: snug, not tight, level all round.
step.read: Read the number at the end of the tape and type it with the units you chose.

done.title: Thank you, {name}

next.check: Our fitter checks them. If something looks off, we write to you.
next.photos: We delete your photos {days} days after your garment ships; your measurements stay with your profile.
next.noPhotos: You sent no photos: your measurements stay with your profile.
next.again: This link is now used. For new measurements, ask {sender} for a new link.

done.contact: Questions about your measurements or your data
